title: Chicken and Vegetable Tagine
description: A classic French-inspired dish from North Africa, made with flavorful chicken, vegetables, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Cook the fideo pasta according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.

Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, and tagine spice blend. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Transfer the chicken to a baking dish.
Add the onion, carrot, and zucchini to the skillet. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cooked fideo pasta to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Transfer the pasta mixture to the baking dish with the chicken. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
